assumptions: EXPLORATORY DEMO ONLY; NOT VERIFIED FIELD METADATA. All source/receiver elevations are assumed 0 m, not measured. Coordinate uncertainties are set to 0 m only to omit geometric uncertainty from this model, not to claim perfect positioning. One unstacked hit per file and stored samples in V are hypotheses; original STACK=0 is retained. Channel-to-receiver correspondence follows SEG-2 CHANNEL_NUMBER and trace order, not an independent survey. TRS acquisition is reused for apparent MASW exploration, not certified as a MASW field campaign. User confirms vertical geophones, DAQLink 4, hammer switch, no pretrigger, and F1 at x=-15 m before receiver 1; receiver spacing 5 m comes from field notes.
sensitivity_note: Last-channel exclusion is a sensitivity variant, not a bad-channel finding.
